title: The Quiet Room Air Purifier
description: Three-stage air purifier for rooms up to 380 square feet. A washable mesh pre-filter catches hair and lint, an H13 HEPA layer is rated to capture 99.97% of airborne particles down to 0.3 microns, and an activated carbon layer absorbs cooking and pet odours. Four fan speeds, a 24 dB sleep mode, a timer and a filter-life indicator. 120V, 38W, UL listed. One-year warranty.

title: Replacement Filter, Two-Pack
description: Two genuine replacement filters for The Quiet Room Air Purifier. Each combines a pleated H13 HEPA layer rated to 99.97% of particles down to 0.3 microns with an activated carbon outer layer for odours. Sealed individually to keep the carbon fresh until you need it. Roughly six months of daily use per filter. Tool-free installation. Not compatible with other purifier models.

title: The Nightfall Humidifier
description: Ultrasonic cool-mist humidifier with a four-litre tank and up to 30 hours of runtime on the lowest setting. Adjustable mist dial, 360-degree nozzle, automatic shut-off when the tank empties, and a top-fill opening wide enough for a hand to reach inside for cleaning. Runs at about 28 dB. No heating element and no hot water. 120V, 24W. One-year warranty.

description: Set of four plug-in motion-sensor night lights.
